snippet.title: Burning Bridges - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
What are your parents hiding?

In Burning Bridges, you return to your childhood home as a 25-year-old and discover a mysterious box of old videotapes in the attic — a box your parents really don't want you to open.

Explore your family home and uncover a long-hidden secret through '90s home videos, letters and other objects. Learn more about your parents, their former rock band and its mysterious lead singer Tanja as you piece together what happened and decide whether — and how — to confront your parents with the truth.

Burning Bridges combines an explorable 3D-scanned environment with FMV sequences featuring real actors and footage recorded using original '90s camcorders.

Wishlist Burning Bridges now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4756210/Burning_Bridges/
